rationale: The Latin anchors *inscribere* and *inscriptione ornare* ("to inscribe" / "to adorn with an inscription") point directly to the sense of writing or engraving something as a lasting record, which matches inscribe.v.04. The Old English *a-wrítan* in the Elene context refers to the physical act of writing/carving text (e.g. on a surface), consistent with this synset rather than the geometric (inscribe.v.03) or enrollment (enroll.v.01) senses.
